name: ai-assisted-fyp-management
description: AI-Assisted Final Year Project Management System — Phase 1 foundation

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
